annotations.title: Search the services FlareWarden can watch

description: Use this when the user asks whether FlareWarden can watch a third-party service their site depends on (a payment provider, cloud, CDN, email or auth service). Returns matching services with their category and status page, and FlareWarden's public status page when there is one. Not for whether a service is down now: use check_service_status.

query.description: The service's name, such as Stripe or AWS.
